evidence.detail: git ls-remote refs/tags/3.1.74 resolves to installed compiler source commit 1092ec30a3fb1d46b1782ff1b4db5094d3d06ae5.
Pinned emsdk maps version3.1.74 to release bundle c2655005234810c7c42e02a18e4696554abe0352; installer rejects changed/wrong SDK checkout.
All nine primary Emscripten/LLVM/musl license and author files match installed Emscripten3.1.74 bytes; supplemental original runtime copyright headers and dlmalloc dedication retained.
Concrete project dependency inventory excludes Qt,SDL,GL,ManyMouse,nall,Phoenix. Own minimal phoenix::Keyboard stub is not the archived Phoenix library.
Thirty-one Pong/adapters translation units; original netlist/scheduler/chips plus maintained boundaries. Full compiler/linker flags retained.
Seven archives libc++.a,libc++abi.a,libc.a,libcompiler_rt.a,libdlmalloc.a,libnoexit.a,libstubs.a. Linked math has no additional per-file terms.
Actual Vite production output consists of ownfrontend/worker/CSS/icon/HTML and EmscriptenJS/Wasm; injected Vite helpers retain MIT notice. No application runtime dependency imports.
Byte copy of package-lock-pinned node_modules/vite/LICENSE.md; full bundled notices retained conservatively.
Preview/final artifacts include matching wholeproject source archive and complete notice tree; frontend Source links directly to the included available archive.

independent_review.scope: Concrete Pong browser component/notice/source assessment; excludes physical phone readiness, native binaries, SDK/container distribution and other games.
independent_review.evidence: Independent toolchain reviewer compared nine primary SDK notices and Vite license byte-for-byte, reviewed seven linked runtime families, nine musl math member sources, dependency exclusions and matching-source packaging contract. Compiled input count corrected to31 before qualification.

assessment_continuity: The 0.2.1 patch changes NoCPU-owned touch UI and version metadata only. The preserved Pong core, linked SDK runtime families, pinned dependencies and retained notice bytes are unchanged. Build hashes in historical assessment evidence refer to the 0.2.0 component baseline; each current artifact supplies fresh core/web provenance and matching source independently.
